purpose: prospective nested grouped-OOF screen of a frozen Trackastra plus APNCC linear conflict head

scope.fit_folds: the three folds other than outer held and calibration

label_join.proposal_unit: one challenger pair; all rows for a challenger must have one unanimous binary label
label_join.feature_row: the conflict row with minimum APNCC pair-NCC margin at feature index 44; row index breaks ties
label_join.unmatched_full-pool_proposals: inference-only and excluded from fitting, calibration and proposal-precision metrics

linear_head.kind: standardized ridge least-squares binary ranker with an unpenalized intercept
linear_head.solver: numpy.linalg.solve on the fixed normal equations

threshold_selection.candidate_thresholds: unique finite calibration scores in descending order
threshold_selection.objective: maximum accepted labeled support subject to precision; higher threshold breaks ties

deployment.source: every authenticated proposal in the complete geometry-admissible feature cache
deployment.score: held-fold linear score of the limiting 49-D row
deployment.selection: fold-calibrated threshold, node-disjoint greedy order by descending score then challenger identity, then the banked APNCC cap

data.fit_labels: prepared labeled proposals from fit-train105 only
data.held_graph_inference: complete cached proposal pool with exactly one outer-fold model per held video

graph_gate.comparison: candidate OOF Trackastra-linear versus identically reconstructed APNCC on the same held fit videos
graph_gate.next_action_on_pass: validation12-only confirmation; CV57 remains separately gated

execution.fold_checkpoint_unit: one complete fit plus calibration plus held-proposal outer fold
execution.resume_policy: accept only complete checkpoints matching contract, implementation, partitions, inputs and metrics
